C18T1P1.english: When the remaining two thirds of the vast open area are in production, 20 staff will harvest up to 1,000 kg of perhaps 35 different varieties of fruit and vegetables, every day.
C18T1P1.check: 其余三分之二的场地投产后，20名员工每天最多收获1000公斤、或许约35种果蔬；保留两个不同限定语。

C18T1P1.english: I don’t much like the fact, either, that they’ve travelled an average of 2,000 refrigerated kilometres to my plate, that their quality is so poor, because the varieties are selected for their capacity to withstand such substantial journeys, or that 80% of the price I pay goes to wholesalers and transport companies, not the producers.”
C18T1P1.check: 平均冷藏运输2000公里；支付价格的80%归批发商和运输公司。

C18T1P1.english: No soil is exhausted, and the water that gently showers the plants’ roots every 12 minutes is recycled, so the method uses 90% less water than a classic intensive farm for the same yield.
C18T1P1.check: 同等产量下比传统集约农场少用90%的水，不是耗水量为传统农场的90%。

C18T1P1.english: Produce grown this way typically sells at prices that, while generally higher than those of classic intensive agriculture, are lower than soil-based organic growers.
C18T1P1.check: 这种农产品价格通常高于传统集约农业产品，但低于在土壤中有机栽培的产品。

C18T1P2.english: One such approach is called a Timber Stand Improvement (TSI) Cut.
C18T1P2.check: TSI Cut 指改善林分质量的采伐；stand 是具有相似特征的一片林木，即“林分”。

C18T1P2.english: Another approach that might yield a high amount of low-use wood is a Salvage Cut.
C18T1P2.check: 此处指为利用受损、濒死等林木实施的抢救性采伐，不同于改良林分的做法。

C18T1P2.english: A Shelterwood Cut, which only takes place in a mature forest that has already been thinned several times, involves removing all the mature trees when other seedlings have become established.
C18T1P2.check: 指渐伐或庇护木作业，幼苗已经立稳后才移除成熟木；不是把所有树苗清除。

C18T1P2.anchor: their nutrients cycle back into the soil
C18T1P2.english: The tops of trees that have been cut down should be left on the site so that their nutrients cycle back into the soil.
C18T1P2.check: 留在原地的是已经伐下树木的梢头，其养分会回归土壤。

C18T1P3.anchor: over four times the yearly average
C18T1P3.english: Last year, commercial companies, military and civil departments and amateurs sent more than 400 satellites into orbit, over four times the yearly average in the previous decade.
C18T1P3.check: 超过前十年年平均发射数量的四倍，不宜译成“增长四倍”；400多颗是卫星数。

C18T1P3.english: The intergovernmental groups also advise lowering satellites deep enough into the atmosphere that they will burn up or disintegrate within 25 years.
C18T1P3.check: 使报废卫星在25年内烧毁或解体是建议目标，至今只有约一半的任务遵守。

C18T1P3.english: Jah says that it is almost impossible to tell which is correct, unless a third source of information made it possible to cross-correlate.
C18T1P3.check: 需要第三方信息交叉比对同一物体的两种不同轨道记录；紫线不是两个不同物体。

C18T2P1.english: Several hundred years later, it is thought, Stonehenge’s builders hoisted an estimated 80 bluestones, 43 of which remain today, into standing positions and placed them in either a horseshoe or circular formation.
C18T2P1.check: 约80块青石被竖立，其中43块留存至今；若干世纪后的估数并非全址巨石总数。

C18T2P1.english: However, in the mid-20th century, radiocarbon dating demonstrated that Stonehenge stood more than 1,000 years before the Celts inhabited the region.
C18T2P1.check: 放射性碳测年表明巨石阵早于凯尔特人在该地定居一千余年，不能将年代逆置。

C18T2P1.english: In the 1960s, the astronomer Gerald Hawkins suggested that the cluster of megalithic stones operated as a form of calendar, with different points corresponding to astrological phenomena such as solstices, equinoxes and eclipses occurring at different times of the year.
C18T2P1.check: 至日、分日和（日月）食；霍金斯提出的是历法功能假说。

C18T2P2.english: Folklore is full of tales of people who ask for the wrong thing, with disastrous consequences — King Midas, for example, might have wished that everything he touched turned to gold, but didn’t really intend this to apply to his breakfast.
C18T2P2.check: 迈达斯王希望触物成金，但并非真想让早餐也变成金子；用于说明愿望与真实意图的区别。

C18T2P2.english: AI already has some input into how resources are used in our National Health Service (NHS) here in the UK, for example.
C18T2P2.check: 语境指英国国家医疗服务体系，NHS；人工智能已经对资源使用发挥一定作用。

C18T2P2.english: We often ignore the suffering of strangers, and even contribute to it, at least indirectly.
C18T2P2.check: “至少间接地”修饰我们加剧陌生人痛苦的方式。

C18T2P3.english: The Renaissance marked the transition from the 15th century to modernity and took place after the spread of the plague in the 14th century, which caused a global crisis resulting in some 200 million deaths across Europe and Asia.
C18T2P3.check: 约两亿人死亡，范围是欧洲和亚洲；some表示约数。

C18T2P3.english: But from the largest collection of Leonardo’s papers ever assembled, a series of innovative thoughts can be reconstructed regarding the foundation of a new city along the Ticino River, which runs from Switzerland into Italy and is 248 kilometres long.
C18T2P3.check: 提契诺河由瑞士流入意大利，全长248公里。

C18T2P3.english: Indeed, this idea of taking full advantage of the interior spaces wasn’t implemented until the 1920s and 1930s, with the birth of the Modernist movement.
C18T2P3.check: 直到20世纪20至30年代才付诸实施；作者谈内部空间的利用。

C18T3P1.english: The UN estimates that there will be 9.8 billion people living on the planet by mid-century.
C18T3P1.check: 预计到本世纪中叶全球有98亿人，billion在此为十亿。

C18T3P1.english: Stora Enso is Europe’s biggest supplier of cross-laminated timber, and its vice-president Markus Mannström reports that the company is seeing increasing demand globally for building in wood, with climate change concerns the key driver.
C18T3P1.check: 正交胶合木；保持材料名和企业代表Markus Mannström的原拼法。

C18T3P1.english: Fly ash, a byproduct of coal-burning power plants, can be incorporated into concrete mixes to make up as much as 15 to 30% of the cement, without harming the strength or durability of the resulting mix.
C18T3P1.check: 粉煤灰可替代的份额是水泥的15%至30%，分母不是整份混凝土拌合物。

C18T3P2.english: By the following April, the General Engineering Company had received 5,390 deposits for Doble Detroits, which were scheduled for delivery in early 1918.
C18T3P2.check: 指通用工程公司收到了5390笔订金，不是5390美元，也不是已交付5390辆汽车。

C18T3P2.english: By the time the company folded in 1931, fewer than fifty of the amazing Model E steam cars had been produced.
C18T3P2.check: 公司倒闭；到1931年E型蒸汽车产量少于50辆。

C18T3P2.anchor: at least equal to gasoline cars, if not superior
C18T3P2.english: For his whole career, until his death in 1961, Abner Doble remained adamant that steam-powered automobiles were at least equal to gasoline cars, if not superior.
C18T3P2.check: 他坚信蒸汽汽车至少不逊于汽油汽车，说不定还胜过后者。

C18T3P3.english: In the 1930s, Vygotsky emphasised the importance of targeting a student’s specific ‘zone of proximal development’ (ZPD).
C18T3P3.check: 维果茨基的“最近发展区”；指学生在帮助下可能达到的发展水平与独立达到水平之间的区域。

C18T3P3.english: Professor John Hattie, director of the Melbourne Education Research Institute, notes that ‘tracking has minimal effects on learning outcomes’.
C18T3P3.check: tracking是按能力分班；对学习结果影响很小，未说完全没有影响。

C18T3P3.english: And today, more than ever, we need the many to flourish — not suffer at the expense of a few bright stars.
C18T3P3.check: 以……为代价，要让多数学生发展，而非牺牲多数人来成就少数出挑者。

C18T4P1.english: London is home to much of the UK’s green roof market, mainly due to forward-thinking policies such as the London Plan, which has paved the way to more than doubling the area of green roofs in the capital.
C18T4P1.check: 伦敦绿化屋顶面积增至原来的两倍多；不是多出原来的两倍多。

C18T4P1.english: For example, ‘blue roofs’ enable buildings to hold water over longer periods of time, rather than draining it away quickly — crucial in times of heavier rainfall.
C18T4P1.check: “蓝色屋顶”是延长雨水蓄存时间的屋顶，不单指屋顶颜色。

C18T4P1.english: Again, city leaders and authorities have helped push the movement forward — only recently, San Francisco, USA, created a policy requiring new buildings to have green roofs.
C18T4P1.check: 旧金山“直到最近”才制订相关政策；多伦多的政策可追溯到20世纪90年代，两城不可互换。

C18T4P2.english: Psychologist Alfred Binet, the developer of the first intelligence tests, was one of many 19th-century scientists who held that earlier view and sought to quantify cognitive ability.
C18T4P2.check: 比奈是19世纪科学家之一；作者接着另述20世纪初对天赋决定论的反对。

C18T4P2.english: In one key experiment, Dweck divided a group of 10- to 12-year-olds into two groups.
C18T4P2.check: 10至12岁的孩子；实验的两个组不同，不是把年龄分成10岁组和12岁组。

C18T4P2.english: Growth mindset supporters David Yeager and Gregory Walton claim that interventions should be-delivered in a subtle way to maximise their effectiveness.
C18T4P2.check: 干预应采用不显眼的方式；区分心理干预的细致做法和表扬的内容。

C18T4P3.english: Wegener’s basic idea was that many mysteries about the Earth’s history could be solved if one supposed that the continents moved laterally, rather than supposing that they remained fixed in place.
C18T4P3.check: 大陆横向移动，相对的是大陆固定不动；不是指陆地只作垂直升降。

C18T4P3.anchor: Plate tectonics is in many respects
C18T4P3.english: Plate tectonics is in many respects quite different from Wegener’s proposal, in the same way that modern evolutionary theory is very different from the ideas Charles Darwin proposed in the 1850s about biological evolution.
C18T4P3.check: 板块构造理论与魏格纳当初提出的大陆漂移观点并不等同。

C18T4P3.anchor: time aloft in a hot-air balloon
C18T4P3.english: In 1906 he had set a world record (with his brother Kurt) for time aloft in a hot-air balloon: 52 hours.
C18T4P3.check: 1906年兄弟两人创造的纪录是热气球留空52小时；time aloft指停留空中的时长。
